english_verification.review_scope: Read the B50 history template, opening Newshire mission block, native country-name localisation, and selected English Newshire flavour lines covering the Chloromancers, Kettlebrook characters, Verdancy, and later experiments. Read the Newshire infobox, Halfling Recorded History, and List of Rogierian monarchs chunks (three Wiki pages total). The 1517 monarch-list entry explicitly says Newshire's halflings were under the Kingdom of Rogieria; the source does not specify direct rule versus vassalage. Bounded text verification, not a mission-tree audit. Primary compared all native idea names/descriptions by actual current English localisation key. Source ranges may be locator envelopes; conditional and predecessor idea sets remain separate. No formal validators, tests, builds or browser checks were run.
unresolved: The dedicated Newshire Wiki page is only an infobox/category stub; history beyond it comes from related pages.
The Wiki does not establish the Small Fellows' exact departure date or formation year; local files govern the campaign start and formation mechanics.
The Chinese prose calls the family 壶溪; current English flavour text uses Kettlebrook. English rendering follows the native Mod name; the naming difference remains a source/localisation discrepancy.

rationale.campaign_length: 61 direct B50 missions, excluding B10's generic prologue.
rationale.colonization: Adventurer expansion matters early; after formation, the focus shifts to agriculture and regional wars.
rationale.complexity: Nation formation, magic, mercenaries, and a disaster demand ongoing management.
rationale.dark_story: A pastoral comedy turns toward life experiments and the Verdancy.
rationale.difficulty: Halfling armies and an uncontrolled disaster raise the difficulty; it was not quantified in hands-on play.
rationale.diplomacy: Build ties with halflings and dwarves, though neither is the sole focus.
rationale.early_pressure: B10 must first establish the prerequisites for nation formation in Escann.
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: The Chloromancers and life magic directly drive politics, warfare, and disaster.
rationale.narrative_density: The Kettlebrook family and Chloromancers span several phases.
rationale.tall_play: Farmland, markets, and plant magic support domestic development.
rationale.trade_economy: Tea, agriculture, and free markets provide economic content.
rationale.warfare: The adventurers, wars to unify Escann, and special mercenaries form the military arc.

identity.appearance: Does not exist in 1444; formed from the Small Fellows (B10) through an Escanni adventurer nation-founding decision.
identity.formation_scope: When B10 meets the nation-founding requirements, it changes to B50 and replaces its non-generic missions.

national_ideas.scope_note: National traditions, seven national ideas and ambition only; optional idea groups and racial/government bonuses are excluded. Conditional alternatives are separate, not stacked. Adopting new ideas depends on the actual event/decision and player choice.

description.text: Our homeland, the Small Country, is beset by war from all sides and split between foreign rulers. The idea of being free and able to rule ourselves was far from possible, until the miraculous sacrifice of Corin stopped the tide of the Greentide. Now us halflings have a land that we claim as a new Small Country, where we can once more live in peace.
description.text_en: Our homeland, the Small Country, is beset by war from all sides and split between foreign rulers. The idea of being free and able to rule ourselves was far from possible, until the miraculous sacrifice of Corin stopped the tide of the Greentide. Now us halflings have a land that we claim as a new Small Country, where we can once more live in peace.

description.text: Despite the many forces of the Marcher Lords, the sacrifice of Corin, and the endless adventurers, Escann is still a land replete with orcs whose wish is to destroy all that is fair. Even though we wish to be left in peace, that does not mean that we cannot defend ourselves. The Orcward Forts were constructed to hold back these green-skinned monsters from our new home.

description.text: The Peace, Love, and Prosperity Act was signed in order to promote greater economic growth in our nation. Households of at least three children are incentivized with reduced taxes, and workshops that produce an increasing amount of goods produced each year are rewarded with a removal of sales tax on their goods.

description.text: Our dedication to peace and neighbourly conduct can only do so much when our neighbours are less than courteous. In fact, sometimes even young halflings can be rowdy. The Newshire Sheriffs are recruited from the most dedicated to our cause, they should be equally adequate at both stopping crime and the charge of gullible orcs with staff and stone.

description.text: Sometime in the mid sixteenth century a strange phenomenon occurred in Newshire. Pumpkins the size of homes grew from our vines, able to feed a family for weeks. Every year since then, massive pumpkins have grown in Newshire, and we are known far and wide for our equally grand pumpkin pie.

description.text: Throughout the world nations know that Newshire is honest to its word and mission: a new home for halflings, and the continuation of peace for our people. They know that we have no other secrets or ambitions that may tarnish our standing.

description.text: Many years after the Greentide, stories are told about our heroes of old who cleaved the path so that we could live in peace in our Newshire. Some of these heroes still remain, and others still are created in the mission of preserving our nation. It would do well for us to listen to these heroes, for they alone know the vision that our halfling nation needs.

player_overview.avoid_if: Avoid this if you dislike halfling military weaknesses, phased missions, or magical disasters.
player_overview.how_it_plays: Establish the halfling adventurers, form a nation and develop farms and a magical army, then confront unification wars and an uncontrolled experiment.
player_overview.overview: Found Newshire in Escann as the Small Fellows adventuring company. Build tea gardens, markets, and farms; empower the Chloromancers and the Kettlebrook family; and wage war with distinctive plant-themed mercenaries. As magic grows stronger, mages gain political control, and you eventually have to contain the Verdancy. The warm story of a new home slowly puts down unsettling roots.
player_overview.recommended_for: Players who enjoy pastoral development, character-driven stories, plant magic, and a long Escanni campaign.
signature_features: The B10 adventuring company forms B50, with 61 exclusive missions.
Agriculture and plant wizards combine with three types of plant-themed special mercenaries.
A family saga, phased missions, and the Verdancy disaster.
player_overview.tagline: Halflings build a farming nation, then face plant magic spiralling out of control.

reasons: An unusual blend of halfling agriculture and plant magic.
The Kettlebrook family provides a continuing narrative.
The Verdancy makes the pastoral ideal exact a price.
warnings: You must first form the country from the B10 adventurers.
Mage politics and mercenary management are demanding.
The later story includes disaster and life experimentation.

positive_indicators: Provides a home for displaced halflings.
Rescues agriculture and the local economy after flooding.
values.rationale: Resettling halflings, rescuing agriculture, and supporting public life have clear benefits. The instrumental treatment of locals and orcs, mages' erosion of elections, and uncontrolled experiments weigh against dignity, personhood, and restraint. War and magic are not deductions by themselves.
red_flags: Treatment of orcs and local residents includes coercion.
The plant experiment spirals out of control and weakens public political influence.
